query:
UPDATE event_series
             SET title = $3,
                 category_id = $4,
                 time_zone = $5,
                 local_start = $6::text::timestamp,
                 duration_minutes = $7,
                 repeat_rule = $8,
                 until_instant = 'epoch'::timestamptz + $9::bigint * interval '1 millisecond',
                 updated_at = now()
             WHERE id = $2 AND user_id = $1
